description: Tell whether a date is a working day in a country (not a weekend there, not a public holiday), and give the next and previous working days. Knows local weekends (Friday–Saturday in Saudi Arabia, Israel, Egypt…). Default date is today in that country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP, IN, AE

extraHolidays.description: Company days off to treat as holidays

includeBank.description: Also treat bank holidays as days off (default: public holidays only)

region.description: Optional state/region code, e.g. CA (California) for US, BY (Bavaria) for DE. Regional holidays differ.

name: world_is_business_day
